query:
MATCH (u:User)-[:HasProfileArtifact]->(browser:ProfileArtifact)-[browserEdge:FoundOn]->(c:Computer)<-[dpapiEdge:FoundOn]-(dpapi:ProfileArtifact)<-[:HasProfileArtifact]-(u)
WHERE browser.category = "browser_store" AND dpapi.category = "dpapi_material"
RETURN u.name AS User, c.name AS Computer, browser.artifacttype AS BrowserArtifact, dpapi.artifacttype AS DPAPIArtifact, browserEdge.profilepaths AS BrowserProfilePaths, dpapiEdge.profilepaths AS DPAPIProfilePaths, browserEdge.findingids AS BrowserFindingIds, dpapiEdge.findingids AS DPAPIFindingIds
ORDER BY User, Computer
name: Profilehound - Browser and DPAPI Co-Location
description: Finds users with browser-store and DPAPI-material artifacts on the same computer.
